extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and applicants to SSHRC funding competitions (and other stakeholders interested in SSHRC merit review processes)
extracted.subtask_description: Description of SSHRC merit review committees that evaluate applications to SSHRC competitions, listing committee memberships by competition and year and stating the basis for evaluation. Useful for applicants, reviewers, and administrators seeking how applications are assessed and which competitions had committees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic excellence and other selection criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Merit review committees evaluate all SSHRC applications based on academic excellence and other selection criteria, and make recommendations about which projects to fund.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This statement defines the basis on which SSHRC merit review committees assess applications. The page lists specific competitions and years for which committees were convened (e.g., Insight Grants, Connection Grants, Partnership Grants, SSHRC Doctoral and Postdoctoral Fellowships, Knowledge Synthesis Grants, etc.), indicating that these committees apply the stated evaluation basis to those competitions.
